name: Lord of Eroded Primal Fire
storytitle: "The Slain Dragon Molded" Lord of Eroded Primal Fire
storytext: A monster of the void, known as both the Reaper of the Abyss and "Gosoythoth." It is able to corrupt memories contained within the Ley Lines, congealing them into tangible forces of catastrophic portent.
source: Reward for accepting the Tavern Challenge at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire
